title: docs(spec): state the publish/install bound on Seed.locale
body:
Fixes #17011

Clause-②: no

Three wording edits, their regenerated reference pages, and a changeset. ⛔ No code behaviour change on any path.

## The card's title is the thing NOT to implement

The card says `Seed.locale` is silently inert on three publish/install paths. The director seat ruled that premise **false** — one-class self-adjudication, comment 5615361502, option **A — 不扩散** — and ordered a correction to the wording, not to the wiring. Quoted verbatim rather than translated:

> 今天已是「有边界的声明 + 运行时点名警告」,不是静默失效 … `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx:226` 已白纸黑字声明这三条路装全部数据并警告 ⇒ 无违约、非缺陷

and 「无代码行为变更、无 changeset 破坏性条目」.

## The three edits

**1. `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` — `SeedSchema.locale`.** The `.describe()` now reads:

> Applicable locales (BCP-47 tags); omitted applies to every locale. The publish and install paths do not filter by locale — they load every dataset and warn

Its TSDoc gains a paragraph naming the bound, why it is the contract rather than an unfinished path, and the ruling.

**2. `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`.** The warn callout that already declared this behaviour for the embedding-host case gains a paragraph naming the three paths explicitly and citing the ruling.

**3. `packages/spec/liveness/seed.json`.** The `locale` row's note ended 「Filed as its own card」. It now cites the ruling, records that what was owed was wording and not wiring, and states the one reading that would reopen it.

Plus `content/docs/references/**` — four pages regenerated by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:docs`. Auto-generated, not hand-edited; the whole diff is that one describe line in the four pages that embed `SeedSchema`.

⚠️ **A line-number drift worth recording, not a missing target.** Triage and the dispatch both anchor the docs paragraph at `:226`. At this branch's base that line is the *info* callout; the warn callout carrying the quoted text is at `:234`. The quoted text matches verbatim, so the anchor is the text and the target is present — the number moved by 8 lines since the triage reading at `ae19f5e`.

## The ruling's load-bearing premise was re-derived, not inherited

The ruling rests on one measurement: zero real seed data using `locale` repo-wide. Re-derived here with an independent instrument, anchored to `1f53b0b685`, reach **this repo, whole tree**:

- **Structural.** A balanced-paren scan of every `defineSeed(...)` call site: **49 sites across 9 files**. The `examples/` apps hold **24** of them — real first-party seed data — and **none declares `locale`**. The scan is **self-lit**: the same pass does find the two `locale`-declaring call sites on the docs page, so the zero is a reading and not a dead instrument.
- **Textual, both axes, one probe shape.** An array-literal probe finds `locale` in **7** files and the sibling axis `env` in **35**. None of the 7 is seed data: the #16595 changeset, the docs page that teaches the key, the loader, the producer, two test files and the liveness ledger.
- **Non-`defineSeed` authoring surfaces.** Zero seed-shaped JSON/YAML artifacts in the tree, zero YAML `locale:` sequences. The single `locale` token inside `examples/app-showcase/src/data/seed/index.ts` is a comment about pinyin search recall at `:111`, not a scope key — and that same unscoped dataset deliberately mixes a CJK-named account in with English ones.

⇒ the premise reproduces, so the three edits proceed.

⚠️ **The ruling's own confidence gap stayed open and is not claimed otherwise.** cloud, hotcrm and external customer apps are out of reach from this repo; they were **not measured** here. A measured use of `locale`-scoped seed data in any of them reopens the decision.

⚠️ **One qualification on the control, reported because it reads differently than the thread implies.** The `env` control is lit — the probe does reach authored seed declarations, which is exactly what triage claimed for it. But `env`'s footprint is tests and docs: of the same 24 real `examples/` datasets, **zero** declare `env` either. So the control proves the instrument works; it does not show a sibling axis in heavy first-party use. This strengthens option A rather than weakening it, and it is not a contradiction of the ruling — only of a wider reading someone might take from "23 files".

## ⛔ Deliberately not done

- ⛔ The three call sites still pass no `locale`. That is option B; it was not ruled. It would give one concept two sources of truth and would silently stop loading a dataset that loads today.
- ⛔ `warnOnUnresolvedLocaleScope` is untouched and still warns. Turning it into a refusal is option C; also not ruled — 「在零使用下买不到安全,只买到一次破坏性变更」.
- ⛔ Reconciling rows already written under a different locale is #16596 and is not addressed here.
- ⛔ No label, assignee, ready-flip, auto-merge or enqueue from this branch; `content/docs/releases/` untouched.

## Changeset — measured, not assumed

`npm pack --dry-run --json` on `packages/spec`, 277 files in the tarball, with controls in both directions:

| path | ships? |
|---|---|
| `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` | **yes** — `src/**/*.zod.ts` |
| `packages/spec/liveness/seed.json` | **yes** — `liveness` |
| `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` | no — not inside any package |
| `packages/spec/src/data/seed.test.ts` (negative control) | no — filter is real |
| `packages/spec/src/data/seed-loader.zod.ts` (positive control) | yes — the glob is live |

⇒ this PR **does publish**, so a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec` is owed and included. `skip-changeset` would be wrong here. Not breaking, so no ADR-0087 marker is owed.

| `check:docs-transcript-drift` | **NOT MEASURED** at the time this body was written — `exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, needs `@objectstack/lint` built, which was queued behind another agent's hold on the shared verify lock. Its own output states this is neither a pass nor a finding. The reading is reported in the dispatch report comment on #17011. |

**Lint, as a proven narrowing rather than a skipped run.** ① Population: `eslint.config.mjs` lints `**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}` and declares no block for `.md`, `.mdx` or `.json`, so exactly one file in this diff is in the linted population. ② Count, from `--format json`: 1 file linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings, exit 0. ③ Invariance: this repo's config **never enables type-aware linting for any file** — its own header says so and records a measured positive control — so this diff cannot move the verdict on a file it did not touch. Read at `HEAD` = `fd9435b3ba`.

Repo-wide sweeps (`pnpm lint` and the rest of the derived farm) are CI's run, not owed here.

## Acceptance notes

Observations from this pass, ⛔ none filed and none fixed here — they are not in the three filing classes:

- `noted, not filed:` the `.describe()` is now two sentences and long enough that the generated reference tables render it as one wide cell. Cosmetic only; the four pages read fine. Carrier: the next PR to touch `SeedSchema`'s describe.
- `noted, not filed:` the dispatch's file surface characterises `packages/spec`'s `files[]` as carrying "a bare `README.md` and `src/**/*.zod.ts`". The manifest has ten entries, and `liveness` is one of them — which is why the ledger edit publishes too. Partial characterisation in a dispatch note, not a repo defect. Carrier: none.
- `noted, not filed:` `examples/` first-party seed data declares neither `locale` nor `env` on any of its 24 datasets, so the repo ships no worked example of either axis outside docs and tests. An observation about coverage, not a defect or a contract violation. Carrier: whoever next extends the example apps.
